lane: Mobile: Tarot and astrology result-screen copy (value report batch A, Owner approved 21/11)
goal: The free Tarot reading reads as a real reading tied to the person's question instead of apologetic meta-text, and the deep-analysis invitation and confirmation describe what the person receives before what is sent. The astrology deep-read invitation states its outcome.
successCriteria: The free Tarot summary opens with the person's question or topic, names the spread's overall energy (major arcana, dominant suit, reversals) and walks each card in its position with its keywords; it never says the AI has not completed, that the reading is the same for anyone, or that no reading was written for this question.

The source line under a server-drawn reading reads as Nilaza's own reading based on traditional card meanings, still not a certain prediction; the local-fallback line after an AI failure stays honest about the AI not completing.
The deep-analysis panel lists what the analysis contains, uses a filled primary button, and keeps 'only counts when the analysis is delivered'.
The confirmation dialog leads with the value, then states that only the question and cards are sent.
The per-card accordion kicker no longer says 'no reading written for this question'.
The astrology deep-read blurb names what the person receives.
untouchedSurfaces: Edge Functions, prompts (the 'concise' instruction is batch C), migrations, quotas and model routes are unchanged.
The 78 card meanings in packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json are unchanged here; their rewrite goes through the Tarot content QC gate as batch A part 2.
Guest flow, clarifier, lock rules and Nil behaviour are unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Tarot result screen after a server draw or local fallback; Tarot deep-analysis confirmation; Astrology deep-read card.
impact.dataWrite: The free summary text saved with a reading changes wording only; reading shape and storage keys are unchanged.
impact.backendContract: No API change; the same drawId retry path runs the AI after confirmation.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change; the Admin workflow catalog digest for App.tsx is refreshed.
impact.privacySafety: Copy stays reflective: no certain predictions, no mind-reading of another person; the privacy statement stays in the confirmation dialog.
impact.observability: No new events; the existing feedback report still lists the summary section.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; saved readings keep whichever summary text they were created with.

canonicalContracts: apps/mobile/src/features/tarot/readingPresentation.ts tarotSourceLabel stays the only source-line writer
packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json stays the only card-meaning source
